profile.tagline: I build modern, scalable and user-focused web applications with clean architecture and thoughtful user experiences.
profile.philosophy: Good software is boring in the best way: predictable structure, honest naming, small components, and no cleverness that a teammate has to reverse-engineer at midnight. I optimise for the person who reads the code next.
profile.learningJourney: I started with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, moved through PHP and Laravel for backend fundamentals, then settled on TypeScript end to end. Each project on this site marks a step in that path — from first CRUD apps to typed, multi-service applications.

bio.1: I am a full-stack developer focused on the Vue and Nuxt ecosystem, with a strong interest in type-safe architecture, API design and interface craft.
bio.2: I enjoy the full arc of building a product — modelling the data, designing the API surface, and then shaping an interface that feels fast and effortless to use.
bio.3: Most of my work so far has been self-directed: study projects, open-source experiments and small client builds where I own the decision-making end to end.

focus.1: Production-grade Nuxt 4 architecture and server routes
focus.2: PostgreSQL schema design and query performance
focus.3: Design systems with Tailwind CSS v4 tokens
focus.4: Testing strategy and CI for full-stack apps
